depth.text: the holes encountered 23.5 m of 0.58 g/t Au at a depth of 484.5 m; a second hole carried 9.0 m of 1.32 g/t Au at a depth of 489.0 m, indicating that gold mineralization continues with depth.

metallurgy.summary: preg-robbing, arsenic-bearing; processed by flotation to concentrate, then cyanide leach (CIL/CIP), then gravity recovery; stated recovery Au 90%
